subject: Secure development evidence request — code review, CI/CD, secrets, change logs
messages:
From: Evan Blake <evan.blake@compliance-consult.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Cc: security@fintech-corp.com
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Request: secure development evidence for SIG/FinTech RFP

Hi Hannah,

FinTech's procurement team and our auditor are moving forward with the SIG review. Can you provide the following artifacts by EOB 2026-10-14: 

- Code review policy and an example redacted PR showing review comments and merge approvals (we only need PHI/PII redacted).
- CI/CD pipeline control list and recent pipeline run logs for the last 30 days (redacted build IDs are OK).
- Secrets management evidence: rotation logs, KMS CMK rotation dates, and an explanation of ephemeral credential use.
- Change management evidence for production-impacting releases (ticket IDs, owner approvals, rollback runbook).
- Any SOC2 mapping or control crosswalk you have for Secure SDLC controls.

If you can share a secure upload link or GDrive folder with limited access, that works — we prefer not to receive binaries over regular email. Let me know if you need a POA/bridge letter or an NDA amendment.

Thanks,
Evan
Evan Blake
Senior Compliance Consultant
Compliance Consult LLP

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
To: dev.patel@redwood.ai, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 10:03:00 -0400
Subject: Fwd: Request: secure development evidence for SIG/FinTech RFP

Team — forwarding FinTech's request (see below). Evan asked for a consolidated package by next Wednesday EOB. Can we assemble the artifacts and a short cover memo that maps files to the SIG questions?

Specific asks: code review sample, CI/CD control list + logs (30 days), secrets rotation evidence, change tickets for production releases, SOC2 mapping. If anything needs legal or procurement sign-off before sharing, flag it and loop Laura/Legal.

Please reply with what you can deliver and any blockers by EOD today.

Thanks,
Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 11:22:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: secure development evidence for SIG/FinTech RFP

Hannah — thanks, we'll get this pulled together. Quick status: 

1) Code review:
- Policy doc: ci-pipeline-policy.pdf (includes branch protection & required reviewers).
- Example PR: code-review-sample-redacted.patch (redacted commit hashes and any customer data). PR ID: RDW-PR-4721 (redacted snapshot attached).

2) CI/CD:
- Control doc and pipeline definition: ci-pipeline-policy.pdf (sections 2-4).
- Pipeline run logs (last 30 days): secrets-rotation-log.csv (this contains timestamps of rotation events and masked values for telemetry). For full pipeline logs we will upload redacted run logs to the GDrive link below.

3) Secrets management:
- Rotation evidence: secrets-rotation-log.csv (includes KMS CMK rotation dates).
- We use AWS KMS for CMKs + Vault for short-lived tokens; see kms-rotation-policy.pdf for schedule & owner.

4) Change management:
- Production change ticket export: change-log-ticket-INC-8345.txt (shows approvals and rollback checklist). Major releases are gated by 2 approvers and SRE signoff.

I've staged these artifacts in a restricted GDrive folder (link below). I flagged anything that mentions customer data for redaction; the sample PR is scrubbed. If FinTech needs signed attestations for any of the files, let me know and I'll coordinate with Legal.

GDrive (restricted): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cSDLC-evidence
Upload planned today; I'll notify when the folder ACLs are set.

— Dev
Dev Patel
Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Oct 2026 12:15:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: secure development evidence for SIG/FinTech RFP

I pulled together the control narrative and one supplemental item (attached). Notes: 

- kms-rotation-policy.pdf describes CMK rotation cadence (annual rotation for root CMK, quarterly for service keys) and who signs the rotation runbook.
- We issue short-lived Vault tokens for CI jobs; Vault leases are automatic and rotated with each pipeline run. Secrets rotation log contains the timestamps and responsible engineers (user IDs only).
- For SOC2 mapping, see section 6 of ci-pipeline-policy.pdf — I've added a short mapping table internally; if the auditor wants the mapping exported I'll prepare that as a separate spreadsheet.

Two things to flag: 
1) Some pipeline logs contain customer IDs in trace metadata. We redacted those and added a line-item in the cover memo documenting redaction rules.
2) If FinTech requires signed attestations for rotation dates, Legal will need to approve the exact language (I can draft).

Attached: kms-rotation-policy.pdf

Mina
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

Hannah — thank you to you and the team for the quick turnaround. I see the GDrive link and the first set of attachments. A few follow-ups before we close the package: 

- Please include explicit PR IDs and timestamps in the cover memo for traceability (we need to show reviewer names and approval times). If reviewer names are personal data, redacted user IDs are acceptable but please map them internally.
- We need a short attestation that pipeline logs are complete for the requested window (or a note describing any gaps).
- Can you provide the signed bridge letter / POA for evidence sharing? We can accept a DocuSign link.

I'll provision a secure upload on FinTech's portal and send a transfer ID once your ACLs are set. Transfer link: https://fintech-portal.example.com/upload/transfer-id-97f2

If you can send the updated memo + attestation by tomorrow morning, we should be able to incorporate it into the SIG review without extra back-and-forth.

Best,
Evan
